groups.rationale: Reviewed the Mila device-features integration (M5 client side): push registration machine, Susan key client and device registrar, end-to-end poke opening against the shared vectors, iOS notification extension and Android messaging service, app lock, offline snapshot cache, notifications settings, single-instance Linux runner and the mila-desktop machine test (7 subtests passed). Mila remains a client: no Ash domain, resource, host or deployed service; chapters 01, 17, 21 and 22 and the generated views are unchanged.
